scope: directional continuous-certificate audit; one channel per scene, not full-strategy clearance performance

sampling.world: independent local Arena worlds; total sources uniform integer 10..16; all sources directional; distinct random channels
sampling.source_position: uniform area in closed radius-1800 disk via r=1800*sqrt(U), theta=2*pi*U
sampling.target_channel: exactly 50% occupied, 50% absent; uniformly selected within each condition; evaluation balance is not an operational prior
sampling.routes: four profiles equally frequent; template routes independently rotated and shuffled; missing-outer deletes one of 12 outer receivers; inside_random has 8..24 uniform-area points within radius1750
sampling.boundary: 360 equally spaced angles, source radius1800, reception1000, outward heading; complete-present/missing-present/missing-empty each 360 cases
sampling.decision_input: only one channel's actual no_signal prefix; direction/near ends the decision before any further certificate call

denominators.false_empty_over_empty_verdicts: false_empty_count / empty_verdict_count; null if no empty verdict
denominators.false_empty_over_source_present: false_empty_count / source_present_count; false-positive rate conditional on an occupied target channel
denominators.empty_channel_certificate_trigger_rate: true_empty_verdict_count / source_absent_count; includes deliberately incomplete routes
denominators.prefix_checks: diagnostic repeated checks within cases, not independent samples; no confidence interval treats prefixes as independent
denominators.zero_error_bound: when zero errors are observed, 1-0.05**(1/n), with n separately equal to occupied cases or empty verdicts; null for zero denominator or deterministic boundary fixtures

monte_carlo.zero_error_bound_scope: one-sided 1 - 0.05**(1/n); model-conditional independent-case reference; see sampling limits

boundary.zero_error_bound_scope: not applied to deterministic boundary fixtures or unspecified sampling

boundary/complete_present.zero_error_bound_scope: not applied to deterministic boundary fixtures or unspecified sampling

boundary/missing_outer_empty.zero_error_bound_scope: not applied to deterministic boundary fixtures or unspecified sampling

boundary/missing_outer_present.zero_error_bound_scope: not applied to deterministic boundary fixtures or unspecified sampling

monte_carlo/inside_random.zero_error_bound_scope: one-sided 1 - 0.05**(1/n); model-conditional independent-case reference; see sampling limits

monte_carlo/mesh25_complete.zero_error_bound_scope: one-sided 1 - 0.05**(1/n); model-conditional independent-case reference; see sampling limits

monte_carlo/rings25_complete.zero_error_bound_scope: one-sided 1 - 0.05**(1/n); model-conditional independent-case reference; see sampling limits

monte_carlo/rings25_missing_outer.zero_error_bound_scope: one-sided 1 - 0.05**(1/n); model-conditional independent-case reference; see sampling limits

limitations: Zero sampled false-empty decisions is empirical evidence, not a proof of zero risk or a formal-server result.
One independently generated scene contributes one selected channel; repeated silent prefixes from the same scene are dependent and never increase the confidence-bound denominator.

The one-sided zero-error bound assumes independent Bernoulli cases with a common conditional error probability within each random-route stratum. Pooled bounds are model-conditional references for this balanced design, not a distribution-free guarantee for deployment or deterministic boundary fixtures.
Safety depends on the published minimum reception radius, source disk and closed 180-degree beam assumptions.
The mathematical certificate proves absence; inability to construct a certificate means unresolved, including numerical fail-closed cases.
Route generation and channel balance are audit distributions; certificate trigger rates are not production-strategy trigger rates.
